title: Recovering the Auxiliary String
statement: For arbitrary bit strings $x,U,t,a,j,p$, form the nested encoding $\langle\langle x,U\rangle,\langle\langle t,a\rangle,\langle j,p\rangle\rangle$. Applying the total second projection, then the total first projection, then the total second projection to this encoding recovers $a$.
